title: We’re Hiring: AI Video Creator
description:
**Company:** AIGinno  
**Location:** 904, Radiance 4, Gota, Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Work Mode:** Full-time, Work from Office  
**Experience:** 1 to 3 years preferred  
**Salary:** ₹25,000 to ₹30,000 per month  
**Joining:** Immediate joiners preferred. A notice period of up to 1 week is acceptable.

At **AIGinno**, we work with multiple SaaS products and AI tools. We are looking for an **AI Video Creator** who can create product tutorials, feature walkthroughs, use-case videos, and other educational content using AI video tools.

This role is for someone who enjoys understanding software, explaining how things work, writing scripts, and turning them into clear, useful videos.

You will spend most of your time researching products, planning video content, writing scripts, recording product workflows, and creating videos using tools such as Guide, HeyGen, and similar platforms.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Understand SaaS products:** Learn how different software products work, including their features, workflows, and use cases.
* **Research and plan:** Study product documentation, explore features, and research topics before creating each video.
* **Write video scripts:** Create clear, simple scripts for product tutorials, feature demos, how-to videos, and use-case videos.
* **Work with the team:** Ask questions, discuss ideas, and brainstorm with team members to understand product workflows and key details.
* **Record product workflows:** Capture on-screen actions, software demos, and step-by-step tutorials.
* **Create AI videos:** Use tools such as Guide, HeyGen, and other AI video platforms to produce videos with screen recordings, AI avatars, voiceovers, and other useful elements.
* **Edit and improve videos:** Add captions, transitions, callouts, and other elements to make videos easy to follow.
* **Review video quality:** Check scripts, product steps, voiceovers, and final videos for accuracy before publishing.
* **Maintain a content workflow:** Manage multiple video tasks and deliver videos according to the content plan.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 1 to 3 years of experience in video creation, video editing, tutorial creation, or a similar role is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with AI video tools such as HeyGen, Guide, or similar platforms.
* Good English-speaking skills and the ability to create clear English scripts.
* Good writing skills and the ability to explain software features in simple language.
* Basic knowledge of screen recording, video editing, voiceovers, and captions.
* The ability to understand software products and explain their workflows step by step.
* Good research skills and attention to detail.
* Confidence in asking questions and working with team members to understand product features.
* Willingness to learn new AI tools and improve video creation skills.

**What Kind of Videos Will You Create?**

You will create different types of videos for SaaS products, including:

* Product tutorials and step-by-step guides
* Feature walkthroughs and software demos
* Use-case videos for different industries and user roles
* Getting-started guides for new users
* AI-generated videos with avatars and voiceovers
* Educational videos that explain how specific features work
* Short videos for social media and product promotion

**Who Should Apply?**

This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys both technology and video creation.

You do not need to be an expert in every AI tool. However, you should have some hands-on experience creating videos and be comfortable learning new tools. We can provide product training and help you understand the software you will be working with.

We are looking for someone who can take a topic, understand it, write a script, create the video, and check the final output with minimal supervision.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can share their resume along with samples of videos they have created. Experience with product tutorials, software walkthroughs, AI avatars, or screen-recorded demos will be a plus.

**If you enjoy creating videos and explaining how software works, we would love to hear from you!**

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Role:** Talent Acquisition Specialist

**Company name:** AVI Renewable Energy Private Limited

**Job location:** Ashram Road, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (On-site)

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**About the Role**

AVI Renewable Energy Private Limited is looking for a proactive and results-driven **Talent Acquisition Specialist** to strengthen our recruitment function and support business growth.

The ideal candidate will play a critical role in attracting, evaluating, and hiring high-quality talent while strengthening our employer brand. The role demands **strong sourcing capability, market networking,** and **industry-aligned recruitment expertise**. Designation will be commensurate to the competencies, academics and experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner closely with hiring managers and functional heads to **understand workforce requirements** and **define candidate selection criteria** aligned with organizational objectives
* Develop and refine clear, **role-specific job descriptions** aligned with business needs in consultation with stakeholders
* Proactively source and headhunt candidates through platforms such as LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, and other professional networks
* Building a pool of candidates for every role (critical and high attriting roles) through **effective networking**
* Act as a **LinkedIn networking champion**, leveraging advanced search techniques, talent mapping, and relationship-based sourcing
* Conduct comprehensive candidate screenings to **assess basic technical competence, cultural alignment**, and **growth potential** by managinginitial interview discussions, including suitability assessment, Test administration, Location mapping, candidate motivation, personality evaluation, and compensation expectations
* Clearly **communicate organizational culture, compensation structure,** and **benefits** to candidates to ensure a transparent hiring experience and reduce post joining attrition
* Maintain **accurate recruitment records, interview feedback,** and **documentation** for compliance and decision-making
* Build and sustain **future-ready pipeline** by nurturing relationships with past and prospective candidates
* Stay current with emerging recruitment trends, tools, and best practices to enhance hiring effectiveness
* Lead **employer branding initiatives** to position the organization as an employer of choice
* Prepare and share **periodic recruitment MIS, dashboards,** and **key hiring metrics** for data-driven insights
* Undertake additional recruitment or HR-related responsibilities as assigned

**Required Skills**

**Recruitment & Sourcing Expertise**

* Strong exposure to end-to-end recruitment lifecycle management
* Proven **recruitment experience**, particularly in hiring for roles up to the mid-level.
* Demonstrated capability in **LinkedIn networking, talent mapping, and passive candidate engagement**
* Ability to manage multiple open positions within defined timelines
* Effective time management and adherence to hiring timelines
* High level of process orientation and compliance

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Strong communication and negotiation skills
* Ability to build relationships for sourcing and employer branding

**Adaptability & Analytical Ability**

* Quick learner with high adaptability to dynamic hiring needs
* Strong problem-solving and analytical ability
* Comfortable with recruitment technologies and digital platforms

**Personal Attributes**

* Ability to work calmly under pressure
* Strong presentation and interpersonal skills
* Self-motivated, results-oriented, and proactive
* Collaborative team player

**Eligibility Criteria**

* **Education:** Master’s/ PGD in HR, else Bachelor in Engineering
* **Experience:** Minimum 1 year in Talent Acquisition or Recruitment
* **Computer Skills:** Excellent proficiency in MS Excel, Hiring Portals’ usage, and professional email drafting
* **Languages:** Fluent in English and Hindi. Gujarati will be an advantage
* **Age:** 21 to 30 years preferred
* **Industry Preference:** Prior recruitment exposure to Solar, Renewable Energy, or EPC sector will be strongly preferred

Pay: ₹22,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Do you have prior recruitment exposure to Solar, Renewable Energy, or EPC sector? If not, name the sectorial experience.
* What is your current CTC in Lakhs per annum?
* What is your expected CTC in Lakhs per annum?
* What is your notice period?
* How many years of experience do you have in Sourcing Resumes?
* Are you comfortable working in a 6-days working company?
* Are you Master’s/ PGD in HR, else Bachelor in Engineering?
* Where are you currently residing in Ahmedabad? Please note that this position is open only to candidates currently residing in Ahmedabad. Candidates based outside Ahmedabad are requested not to apply.
* Are you proficient in MS Excel at an intermediate to advanced level, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, IF functions, conditional formatting, data cleaning, MIS reporting, and basic data analysis? This role requires hands-on expertise in Excel for recruitment reporting, KPI tracking, and data-driven analysis. Please apply only if you can independently perform these tasks using MS Excel.
* Are you confident and capable of independently managing the entire end-to-end recruitment cycle, from sourcing and screening candidates to interview coordination, offer management, and onboarding?

Experience:

* Full-cycle recruitment: 1 year (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: UK Recruiter
description:
Recruitment Consultant – UK Recruitment / RPO

**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office  
**Experience:** 1–2 Years  
**Salary:** ₹25,000–₹30,000 per month (Take-home)  
**Open Positions:** 6  
**Working Hours:** 12:30 PM – 10:00 PM (UK Shift)  
**Joining:** Immediate joiners preferred  
**Interview Process:** 2 Rounds – Virtual and Walk-in  
**Job Type:** Full-time

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated and target-driven Recruitment Consultant to join our UK-focused recruitment delivery team in India.

The role involves sourcing, screening, engaging, and coordinating candidates for vacancies across the UK market. You will work closely with international clients and recruitment stakeholders to deliver qualified candidates within agreed timelines and service-level requirements.

Candidates with experience in UK recruitment, international recruitment, RPO, or volume hiring will be preferred.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage recruitment delivery for assigned vacancies across the UK market.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, CV databases, referrals, and direct sourcing.
* Review resumes and shortlist candidates against job descriptions and hiring criteria.
* Conduct initial candidate screening and competency-based interviews.
* Contact candidates to explain job opportunities, role requirements, and recruitment processes.
* Build and maintain an active pipeline of qualified candidates.
* Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Support offer management, onboarding coordination, and pre-employment checks where applicable.
* Maintain accurate candidate records in applicant tracking systems (ATS) and CRM platforms.
* Monitor recruitment progress against client SLAs, KPIs, and deadlines.
* Prepare regular recruitment updates and activity reports.
* Build professional relationships with candidates and maintain a positive candidate experience.
* Coordinate with account managers, recruitment leads, and UK-based stakeholders.
* Handle candidate information confidentially and follow applicable data-protection requirements.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* 1–2 years of relevant recruitment experience.
* Experience in candidate sourcing, screening, and interview coordination.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn, Indeed, Reed, Totaljobs, or similar recruitment platforms.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Understanding of recruitment processes and the candidate lifecycle.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and candidate pipelines simultaneously.
* Strong follow-up, organisational, and relationship-management skills.
* Ability to work with targets, KPIs, deadlines, and client requirements.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and ATS/CRM systems.
* Attention to detail and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Experience

Experience in any of the following recruitment areas will be an advantage:

* UK Recruitment and International Recruitment
* UK Healthcare and NHS Recruitment
* Social Care, Nursing, and Medical Recruitment
* IT and Engineering Recruitment
* Professional Services Recruitment
* Volume Recruitment
* Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) or Managed Service Provider (MSP) recruitment
* Contract and Temporary Staffing

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance may be assessed using relevant recruitment delivery metrics, including:

* Qualified candidates sourced
* CV submissions
* Interviews arranged
* Interview-to-offer conversion
* Offer-to-joining conversion
* Successful placements and hires
* Time to fill vacancies
* Candidate response rates
* Client SLA achievement
* Recruitment pipeline activity and follow-up completion

What We Offer

* Exposure to the UK recruitment market.
* Opportunities to work with international clients.
* Experience in a structured RPO recruitment environment.
* Training and professional development.
* Performance-based incentives, subject to the applicable incentive policy.
* Career progression opportunities toward Senior Recruiter, Team Leader, or Recruitment Manager roles.
* A collaborative and development-focused work environment.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is proactive, organised, and comfortable working toward recruitment targets. They should be able to identify suitable candidates, maintain an active talent pipeline, and coordinate recruitment activities from initial contact through placement.

Candidates with UK recruitment, international staffing, RPO, or volume recruitment experience are encouraged to apply.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed with an updated resume highlighting their recruitment experience, sourcing skills, and exposure to UK or international hiring.

**Interview Location:**  
607–608, B Block, Shilp Corporate Park,  
Rajpath Rangoli Road, Ahmedabad, Gujarat.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: IT Resume Specialist
description:
Resume Writer

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Ahmedabad  
**Experience:** 1–3 years  
**Industry:** IT Recruitment / Career Services  
**Shift:** Overnight(US time zone)

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled **Resume Writer** who can create, improve, and customize professional resumes for IT professionals. The ideal candidate should understand different IT roles, be able to identify candidates' key skills and experience, and present them effectively in ATS\-friendly resumes.

Key Responsibilities

* Create and update professional, ATS\-friendly resumes for IT candidates.
* Review candidates' experience, skills, projects, and career goals.
* Customize resumes according to specific IT job descriptions.
* Highlight relevant technical skills, achievements, and experience.
* Ensure resumes are professionally formatted, accurate, and easy to read.
* Optimize resumes with relevant keywords for ATS systems.
* Rewrite existing resumes to improve their impact and presentation.
* Work with recruiters and candidates to gather required information.
* Maintain quality and consistency across all resumes.
* Complete resumes within assigned timelines and meet daily/weekly targets.

Requirements

* 1–3 years of experience in resume writing, career services, recruitment, or a related field.
* Excellent written English and strong grammar skills.
* Strong knowledge of professional resume formatting and ATS optimization.
* Good understanding of IT/technical roles such as Software Developer, Data Engineer, DevOps, Cloud, Cybersecurity, QA, etc.
* Ability to understand technical experience and convert it into strong resume content.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to work with deadlines and handle multiple candidates.

Preferred Skills

* Experience creating resumes for the **US job market**.
* Familiarity with US IT recruitment and job descriptions.
* Experience using resume\-building or document\-formatting tools.
* Knowledge of ATS systems and keyword optimization.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary.
* Performance\-based incentives.
* Professional growth opportunities.
* Training and development.
* Dynamic and collaborative work environment.
* Opportunity to work with IT professionals and US\-based recruitment processes.

Work Location: In person
